evals.prompt: Write an onboarding plan for a new data analyst starting Monday. Buddy is Sam.
evals.expected_output: Writes a plan with pre-day-one access, a day-by-day first week with a first delivered task, checkable 30/60/90 outcomes, people to meet, and check-ins, with TODOs for unknowns.
expectations: First real deliverable in week one

evals.prompt: Just give them the wiki and some docs to read for the first two weeks.
evals.expected_output: Recommends a real starter task in week one alongside limited reading, explaining why.
expectations: Pushes back on a reading-only start

evals.prompt: My new hire is 6 weeks in and hasn't shipped anything.
evals.expected_output: Suggests a reset with a small scoped deliverable, a buddy, and written near-term milestones.
expectations: Proposes a small concrete deliverable with a reviewer
